instruction: Open the Super Bowl event info page on the NFL website.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent started at nfl.com/international, navigated to the Super Bowl section (nfl.com/super-bowl), browsed Event Info, then tried Google search but hit SSL certificate error. Spent remaining turns stuck on error page. Never reached the historical scores page.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate nfl.com via top menu, click Super Bowl section, browse sub-pages (Event Info), interact with address bar, dismiss cookie banners
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to find the historical scores section (/scores/2019/post4). It navigated to the current Super Bowl page instead, then attempted Google search which failed due to SSL certificate error in the VM environment.
metadata.task_rationale: Model demonstrated navigating to the Super Bowl Event Info sub-page in the trajectory. This task tests that specific navigation ability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from nfl.com homepage to Super Bowl Event Info page. Evaluator checks if active URL matches the event-info pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify navigation.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict (type=rule) and accesses rules['expected'] to get the regex patterns list.
Regex pattern 'https://.*nfl\.com/super-bowl/event-info' properly matches the Super Bowl event info page URL regardless of subdomain variations.
Single-step instruction (navigate to a page) is fully covered by the single URL check - no missing verification steps.
No postconfig needed since the URL persists in the address bar after navigation.
